assumptions: The selected Environment Agency LIDAR DTM survey carries the published 0.15 m vertical RMSE evidence.
The parcel lies on mainland Britain when the 0.008 m OSGM15 nominal RMS figure is used.
LIDAR and geoid errors are treated as independent only for this analytical screening calculation.
Minimum and maximum elevation errors are treated as independent for the pairwise screening calculation; spatial correlation may invalidate this assumption.
Boundary uncertainty, raster resolution, surface classification, interpolation and temporal change are separate components and are not hidden inside the numerical RMSE combination.
